question: How resilient is UC Irvine CHRS's own data site (the CHRS Data Portal at chrsdata.eng.uci.edu, and persiann.eng.uci.edu over HTTPS and FTP) as a home for data: who runs it (D-3), storage and copies (D-2, RRS-1), integrity and recovery (RRS-2, RRS-3), institutional support (RRS-4) and track record (RRS-5)? Builds on the 2026-11-19 PERSIANN-CDR Daily runs and the 2026-11-23 GHCN-Daily repository resilience run.
tier_reason: deep: dispute (NSF 2332263 terminated then reinstated; federal grant cuts); user budget 30 min / 240k

subquestions.question: Who built and maintains the CHRS Data Portal and the persiann.eng.uci.edu servers, how many people, whether it depends on one developer, and how it is paid for (D-3)
subquestions.remaining_gap: Who maintains the servers today, the team's size beyond one listed administrator, and how that post is paid are not published.

subquestions.question: Which servers hold the data and where; whether they are backed up and where; whether the CHRS copy is checked against NCEI's (D-2, RRS-1)
subquestions.remaining_gap: Server location, backups and any second site are not published; no check of the CHRS copy against NCEI's was found.

subquestions.question: Checksum or fixity checks and published checksums; UC Irvine backup and disaster recovery policy for research servers; whether CHRS has its own plan and has tested it (RRS-2, RRS-3)
subquestions.remaining_gap: No CHRS checksum, fixity or DR plan published; UCI's backup service is opt-in and not tied to CHRS by any source; current UC IS-12 (2021) text not read.

subquestions.question: Whether UC Irvine gives CHRS space, IT or staff beyond grants (RRS-4)
subquestions.remaining_gap: No campus funding, space or staff commitment to CHRS is published; NOAA and NASA awards not updated since the 2026-11-19 Part 3 run.

subquestions.question: Track record: download links down until 2024-10-11; 2024 files posted October 2025; information tab dated 2020; how the site fared between grants (NSF 2332263 terminated then reinstated); any data lost (RRS-5)
subquestions.remaining_gap: The reason for the 2024 download-link outage, the late 2024 CDR posting and the 2020 info-tab date are not published.
